allowed_overlaps.reason: Both are discovery-stage entry points that can be triggered by an ambiguous 'look into this' request. brainstorm-idea-with-user owns product intent and scope discovery; investigate-existing-codebase owns technical/codebase root-cause discovery. skill-team/v3 defines discovery as non-competing modes, so shared discovery vocabulary (idea, explore, understand, existing) is intentional and must not be flagged as a conflict.

Both can be triggered by a generic 'review this' or 'evaluate this' request. Disambiguated by evidence source: brainstorm-idea-with-user works from conversation/intent before a product necessarily exists in a reviewable state; product-ux-audit requires a real, rendered, navigable product. Intentional discovery-mode overlap, not a conflict.

Both inspect something that already exists. investigate-existing-codebase targets source code and technical root cause; product-ux-audit targets rendered UI/UX only and is explicitly out of scope for backend/logic issues. Intentional discovery-mode overlap, not a conflict.
